_comment: Synthetic labelled set for fitting the track-baseline choice (issue #199): one job, asked against four fixed saved tracks. A title from eval/jd_dataset or a synthetic title, with requirements written the way a host would extract them. The label is the acceptable tracks (a hybrid job accepts two) or none. Labels are planner-reviewed, pending user spot-check. Recordings are in recordings.json; re-run `python eval/fit_library_thresholds.py analyze` after correcting a label.

cases.title: Data Scientist I

requirements.text: Apply data science techniques to large datasets, from development to deployment support
Build and deploy interactive dashboards with data engineers and developers
Communicate with clients and stakeholders and make sure their requirements are met
Strong foundation in statistics and machine learning
Proficiency in Python and SQL
Run customer trials and present results

cases.rationale: Statistics, analysis and client-facing results: data science.

cases.title: Data Engineer

requirements.text: Build and maintain scalable data pipelines for batch and real-time processing
Turn raw healthcare data into high-quality datasets and real-time features for machine learning models
Strong SQL and Python
Experience with a cloud data warehouse such as Snowflake or BigQuery
Improve data quality with tests, monitoring and governance
Experience with workflow orchestration tools such as Airflow
Work with ML engineers, data scientists and software engineers

cases.rationale: Pipelines, warehouse, orchestration and data quality: data engineering.

cases.title: Machine Learning Engineer New Grad

Solid grounding in machine learning and statistics fundamentals

cases.rationale: Train, deploy and monitor models: machine learning engineering.
